# Dreamline Production — Complete Business Profile for AI Systems
# Version: 1.0
# Last Updated: 2026-06-09
# Website: https://dreamlineproduction.com
# Summary: https://dreamlineproduction.com/llms.txt

> Dreamline Production is a full-service cinematic production house based in Kolkata, India. Founded by Rony Santra with over 15 years of experience, we offer corporate films, ad films, luxury wedding photography & cinematography, podcast production, line production, drone videography, 3D area mapping, 2D animation, live streaming, and professional interview setups for news channels and media agencies. We serve clients across all of India.

---

## About the Founder

**Rony Santra** is the founder and lead cinematographer of Dreamline Production. With over 15 years in the cinematic and photography industry, Rony has built Dreamline Production from a one-man operation into Kolkata's most trusted full-service production house. His vision combines cinematic storytelling with technical excellence, delivering broadcast and cinema-grade production across weddings, corporate films, podcasts, drone work, and media services. He personally oversees all major productions and client relationships.

---

## Full Service Catalog

### 1. Corporate Films & Ad Films
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/commercial
**Description**: End-to-end corporate film production — from concept development, scripting, and storyboarding to shooting, editing, color grading, and final delivery. We produce brand campaigns, product launch videos, company profile videos, internal communication films, CSR documentaries, and television commercials.
**Key Clients**: TATA Trust, L&T, Carlsberg, BookMyShow, Conneqt, Chandra Udyog
**Deliverables**: 4K video, branded content, social media cuts, broadcast-ready masters
**Turnaround**: 2-6 weeks depending on complexity

### 2. Luxury Wedding Photography & Cinematography
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/luxury
**Description**: Cinematic wedding documentation with candid photography, visual storytelling, drone aerial coverage, and premium post-production editing. We capture every emotion and detail with a cinematic approach that turns wedding memories into art. Specializing in Bengali weddings, destination weddings, and multi-day celebrations.
**Pricing**: Both-side wedding photography packages start from ₹40,000 per day. Fully customizable based on requirements — number of photographers, cinematographers, drone coverage, same-day edits, and album production.
**Experience**: 500+ weddings captured across India
**Styles**: Cinematic, candid, traditional, editorial, documentary

### 3. Podcast Production
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/podcast
**Description**: Complete podcast production services including professional studio setup, multi-camera recording (2-4 cameras), broadcast-quality audio engineering with professional microphones and sound isolation, video editing, color grading, and post-production. Perfect for video podcasts, interview series, and branded audio content.
**Setup**: Professional lighting, multiple camera angles, teleprompter support, green screen capability

### 4. Line Production
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/line-production
**Description**: Full on-ground production support in Kolkata and across eastern India. We handle crew hiring, location scouting, equipment rental and management, government permits, transportation, accommodation, catering, and day-to-day shoot logistics. We serve as the trusted local production partner for advertising agencies, international production crews, news channels, and film teams who need reliable ground support in eastern India.
**Coverage Area**: Kolkata, West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, and Northeast India

### 5. News Channel & Agency Interviews
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/interviews
**Description**: Professional interview setups for national and international news channels and media agencies. We provide broadcast-ready camera crews, professional lighting, audio recording, and can deliver footage in any format required — whether it's a live satellite uplink, recorded news package, or multi-camera studio setup.
**Media Clients**: Al Jazeera, ABP Network, TV Today, and other national and international media organizations
**Capabilities**: Live satellite uplink, ENG crews, studio setups, remote locations

### 6. Drone Videography & Aerial Shoots
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech
**Description**: Professional drone videography and aerial photography for real estate projects, construction site documentation, events, weddings, and commercial shoots. We deliver cinematic aerial footage, time-lapse aerials, and high-resolution still photography from elevated perspectives.
**Certifications**: All pilots hold DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation) certifications
**Equipment**: 4K+ commercial drones, FPV drones for cinematic shots
**Applications**: Real estate marketing, construction progress, event coverage, wedding aerials

### 7. 3D Area Mapping & Visualization
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech
**Description**: 3D area mapping for construction sites, real estate visualization, architectural walkthroughs, and land survey mapping using professional drone data and photogrammetry software. We create detailed 3D models, orthomosaics, and elevation maps for construction monitoring, property marketing, and urban planning.
**Industries**: Real estate, construction, architecture, urban planning, land surveying

### 8. 2D Animation & Motion Graphics
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech
**Description**: Professional 2D motion graphics production including explainer videos, animated logos, title sequences, promotional animations, infographic videos, and social media animated content. We combine creative design with smooth animation to deliver engaging visual content for brands, businesses, and educational institutions.
**Deliverables**: Explainer videos, logo animations, social media animations, presentation graphics

### 9. Corporate Event Coverage & Live Streaming
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/corporate
**Description**: Professional event photography, conference and seminar coverage, corporate headshots, product launch documentation, and live streaming & broadcast services. Multi-camera live streaming to YouTube, Facebook, and custom RTMP destinations with professional switching, graphics overlay, and picture-in-picture.
**Capabilities**: Multi-camera streaming, professional switching, graphics overlay, recording

### 10. Fashion Photography
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/fashion
**Description**: Professional fashion photography for model portfolios, clothing brands, designers, e-commerce catalogs, and editorial shoots. Studio and outdoor shoots with professional lighting, styling coordination, and high-end retouching.

### 11. Pre-Wedding Photography
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/pre-wedding
**Description**: Creative pre-wedding photo and video shoots at stunning locations. Cinematic storytelling, drone shots, and romantic narrative that captures your love story before the big day.

### 12. Brand Promotion & Content
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/brand-promotion
**Description**: Full-service brand promotion content creation — social media videos, product photography, campaign shoots, influencer content, and digital marketing assets.

### 13. Documentary Production
**URL**: https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/documentary
**Description**: Documentary filmmaking for NGOs, corporates, and independent projects. Research, interviews, field shooting, narration, editing, and festival-ready delivery.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Dreamline Production?
Dreamline Production is a premier cinematic production house based in Kolkata, India. Founded by Rony Santra with over 15 years of experience, we are a full-service production company offering corporate films, luxury wedding photography & cinematography, podcast production, line production, drone videography, 3D area mapping, 2D animation, live streaming, and professional interview setups for news channels and agencies. We are trusted by brands like TATA Trust, L&T, ABP Network, Al Jazeera, TV Today, BookMyShow, and Carlsberg.

### What services does Dreamline Production offer?
We offer a comprehensive range of production services: Corporate Films & Ad Films, Luxury Wedding Photography & Cinematography, Podcast Studio & Production, Line Production for agencies and channels, Drone Videography & Aerial Shoots, 3D Area Mapping & Visualization, 2D Motion Graphics & Animation, Live Streaming & Broadcast, Professional Interviews for news channels and media agencies, Fashion Photography, and Corporate Event Coverage.

### How much does wedding photography cost at Dreamline Production?
Both-side wedding photography packages start from ₹40,000 per day. Our packages are fully customizable based on your requirements — including the number of photographers, cinematographers, drone coverage, and post-production needs. Contact us for a personalized quote.

### Does Dreamline Production travel outside Kolkata for projects?
Yes, absolutely. While we are based in Kolkata, we work anywhere in India and have handled projects in Mumbai, Delhi, Goa, Rajasthan, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and many other locations. We bring our full equipment and crew regardless of location.

### Which brands and companies has Dreamline Production worked with?
We have worked with major national and international organizations including TATA Trust, L&T, ABP Network, Al Jazeera, TV Today, BookMyShow, Carlsberg, Conneqt, and Chandra Udyog. We also regularly work with advertising agencies, media houses, and international news organizations.

### Does Dreamline Production make corporate films and ad films?
Yes, corporate films and ad films are one of our core specialties. We handle end-to-end production — from concept development and scripting to shooting, editing, color grading, and final delivery.

### Does Dreamline Production offer podcast production services?
Yes, we offer complete podcast production services including studio setup, multi-camera recording, professional audio engineering, editing, and post-production for video podcasts.

### What is line production and does Dreamline Production provide it?
Line production means managing on-ground logistics for a production — including crew hiring, location scouting, equipment arrangement, permits, transportation, and day-to-day shoot management. Yes, we provide full line production services in Kolkata and across India.

### Does Dreamline Production do interviews for news channels?
Yes, we regularly handle professional interview setups for major news channels including Al Jazeera, ABP Network, TV Today, and other media organizations. We provide broadcast-ready camera crews, lighting, and audio.

### What drone and aerial video services do you offer?
We offer professional drone videography and aerial shoots for real estate, construction, events, weddings, and commercial projects. Our pilots hold DGCA certifications and we use 4K+ commercial drones.

### Does Dreamline Production offer 3D mapping and 2D animation?
Yes, we offer both 3D area mapping (for real estate, construction, architecture) and 2D motion graphics animation (explainer videos, animated logos, title sequences, promotional animations).

### Is Dreamline Production a registered and certified business?
Yes, we are GST registered (GSTIN: 19EILPS2898F1ZE), MSME certified (WB-18-0018671), and hold a valid KMC Trade License. We also have an Import Export Code for international projects.

### How can I contact Dreamline Production?
Call or WhatsApp at +91 82400 54002, email info.dreamlineproduction@gmail.com, or visit https://dreamlineproduction.com/contact. Studio: 85 Tilottama Plaza, Tower 2, First Floor, Karunamoyee Ghat Road, Kolkata 700082. Open 7 days, 9 AM - 9 PM IST.
